derivation: (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to H6658 (צָדָה) in the sense of intentness;

occurrences.text: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed–nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
